run_process_worker: run an LLVM Gym environment in a background subprocess and return results via a multiprocessing queue
run_process_worker_with_env: step through a list of actions on an existing LlvmEnv and return results via a multiprocessing queue
test_running_environment_in_background_p: test launching and running an LLVM autophase environment in a background multiprocessing process
test_moving_environment_to_background_pr: test that moving an LLVM environment to a background process raises a TypeError on macOS
test_port_collision: test that connecting two LlvmEnv instances to the same service port succeeds without error
